name: znetwork_remove_player_record_by_key
description: zNetwork::RemovePlayerRecordByKey releases a player's color slot and unlinks the matching player-record list node without deleting the player record.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zNetwork DirectPlay/session source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48b9e0 validates the FindPlayerRecordByKey dependency, positive color-index flag clear, sentinel-list traversal, node unlink, node delete, and list-count decrement while leaving the player record allocation untouched.
The native zNetwork remove-player smoke verifies color-slot release, list relinking/count update, missing-key no-op behavior, and that the removed player record remains caller-owned.
